# devocionales/vendor

Third-party assets self-hosted so the page, and its service worker, depend on no CDN.
Do not edit by hand and do not lint (excluded in `.eslintignore` and `.stylelintignore`).

| File | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lucide.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.73.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js | 1.73.0 | ISC (notice kept in the file header) |
| `fonts/inter-latin.woff2`, `fonts/inter-latin-ext.woff2` | Google Fonts, Inter v20 (`fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/`) | v20 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `tailwind.css` | Generated by `scripts/build-tailwind.sh` (Tailwind CLI 3.4.19) | 3.4.19 | MIT |

## Updating

- **Tailwind:** run `bash scripts/build-tailwind.sh` after adding or removing a Tailwind class in
  `devocionales/index.html`, `devocionales/js/*.js` or the shared scripts listed in
  `scripts/tailwind.config.cjs`. Commit the result; CI fails when the committed file is stale.
- **lucide:** download the new `lucide.min.js`, bump the version above, and check every
  `data-lucide` icon still renders.
- **Inter:** only the latin subsets are shipped. Weights 400/600/700/800 are declared in
  `scripts/tailwind.input.css`, matching what the Google stylesheet declared.
